about: Campbell & Associates is a personal injury firm with four offices across New York, including Hamburg, Buffalo and Jamestown.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

G1.evidence: 2 of 8 named attorneys are currently registered and none of those carries an adverse status. 1 other name(s) match a register entry that does: Colin Campbell shares a name with one of 2 registrations, one of them suspended, delinquent. That entry cannot be tied to this firm's attorney and cannot be ruled out either, so the gate is held open rather than decided.
G1.source: NYS Attorney Registrations (data.ny.gov eqw2-r5nb), published by the NYS Unified Court System, incomplete: an adverse namesake we cannot resolve
